From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Lisa Harper <lisa.harper@springwellhealth.com>, Tom Saito <tom.saito@springwellhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: SpringWell activation kickoff — mutual action items & owners

Hi Grace / team,

Quick handoff: we closed SpringWell (deal SW-2027-0912) last week — they'll be live for a phased pilot starting Oct 10. I wanted to surface the key context so CS can hit the ground running.

Essentials (TL;DR):
- Product: Redwood Dedicated (reserved capacity) for inference + SSO + VPC peering.
- First milestone: pilot acceptance (3-week pilot) target window Oct 10 – Oct 31.
- Primary business objective: reduce per-call latency for patient-facing triage flow, target 150–200ms p50.
- MRR/commit: $75k/month committed capacity with optional burst.

Key technical contacts (customer):
- Lisa Harper (Head of Product) — lisa.harper@springwellhealth.com
- Tom Saito (Eng Manager) — tom.saito@springwellhealth.com

Attachments: I uploaded the mutual action plan and the current SOW to the Drive link below and attached stubs.

Immediate asks for CS:
1) Confirm primary CS owner and secondary backup for rollout.
2) Propose 2 available kickoff dates week of Sep 27 (60–90 minute technical + success sync).
3) Pre-kickoff checklist: access to a staging dataset (PII stripped), network diagram for VPC peering, and a security contact for SOC2 evidence requests.

Risk notes (internal):
- Customer has a hard performance SLA requirement; we may need a quantization profile and a warm-cache plan to meet p50 targets.
- Finance has a clause for early-termination credits we agreed to — keep revenue ops in the loop for SOW countersign.

Links and attachments:
- Mutual action plan (Drive): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C-mAP-MutualActionPlan
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/12345/SW-2027-0912
- Attachments: SpringWell_MutualActionPlan_v3.xlsx (xlsx), SOW-SpringWell-RevA.docx (docx)

Karthik
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0137

Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2027 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SpringWell activation kickoff — mutual action items & owners

Thanks for the context, Karthik — appreciated.

Grace here. I'll take primary ownership for the activation and onboard Monica as the delivery lead. Monica — can you be the point for day-to-day implementation tasks and run the weekly check-ins? Vivek I’ll keep looped for escalation and capacity planning.

Proposed kickoff slots (please pick one):
- Tue, Sep 28, 10:00–11:30 PT
- Wed, Sep 29, 14:00–15:30 PT

Pre-kickoff action items (I will own coordination):
- Monica: compile a sprint-zero checklist and list of sandbox tokens we need from them (expected by Sep 24).
- Karthik: share the signed SOW (RevA) with contracts@springwellhealth.com and confirm billing start date.
- Lisa / Tom (customer): share a network diagram for peering + staging dataset pointer before Sep 24.

Internal notes (for the record):
- Performance target looks achievable but will require a dedicated warm-cache policy and a custom batch size profile. We'll request a short performance validation window before production cutover.
- Flagging potential risk: SOC2 evidence may delay peering if their security team requires HSM-backed key management.

I'll send a kickoff calendar invite once we lock a slot and will attach the initial sprint-zero checklist.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.com | +1 917-555-0199
